info.syllabusName: Advanced English Grammar_Ngữ pháp tiếng Anh nâng cao
info.description:
This course aims at:

- Introducing advanced and complex grammar concepts to students

- Instructing students to blend verb tenses effectively and how to punctuate sentences correctly

- Helping students improve their academic English

*Assessment scheme:

1) Ongoing assessment:

Student gets 0.25 bonus points for each course completed on time. The total bonus point is not greater than 1.

2) Theoretical Exam (TE)

3) Final Result (FR) =min (10, TE+ Bonus)

4) Completion Criteria: TE>=4 and FR>=5
info.studentTasks:
1. Join the online course (spec.) when being invited by the admin.

2. Enroll in each MOOC of spec., regularly study MOOCs at least 5hrs/week by watching videos, reading materials, taking quizzes, doing assgnments... as required

3. Respect the Coursera Code of Conduct, at https://learner.coursera.help/hc/en-us/articles/208280036-Coursera-Code-of-Conduct

3. Keep online learning progress promptly (bonus will be awarded)

4. Communicate and discuss in forum

5. Attend off-line sessions in the Campus ( Optional)

6. Must complete all MOOCs of spec. with certification in order to take the Final Exam at Campus

materials.note: SPEC: Learn English: Advanced Grammar and Punctuation Specialization
MOOC 02: Conjunctions, Connectives, and Adverb Clauses
MOOC 04: Advanced Grammar and Punctuation Project

clos.loDetails:
Review all verb tenses; and practice blending and mixing tenses in English
LO1.1 Review verb tenses in English
LO1.2 Fill in any gaps of understanding of verb tenses
LO1.3 Blend and mix tenses in producing language

Develop complex sentences using conjunctions and connective devices
LO2.1 Use conjunctions in sentences
LO2.2 Use connectives in sentences
LO2.3 Use subordinating conjunctions and make adverb clauses
LO2.4 Reduce adverb clauses to make complex sentences

Practice using noun clauses and conditionals in advanced speaking and writing
LO3.1 Identify and apply different types of noun clauses in writing and speaking
LO3.2 Practice conditionals and mix them in English

Practice acquired advanced grammar points in writing
LO4.1 Create a graphic organizer to help remember grammar points
LO4.2 Practice use various grammar points in writing
